criteria.text: Invalid body/coords ⇒ `400`; unknown `sourceId` ⇒ `404`; tracking disabled ⇒ `409`; source unavailable (gimbal not in profile / detached) ⇒ `409` with a curated reason.
`select` while the gimbal's device is disconnected is refused, not queued.
`cancel` is idempotent and always results in `stop()` being sent.
No route blocks on the sidecar: `select` returns after the command is handed to the client (state then flows through status).
Rate-limit or coalesce repeated `select` (e.g. ≥ 250 ms between accepted selects per source).
